name: com.testplay.bridge
description: Warm-editor bridge for the TestPlay Runner CLI (testplay). DORMANT by default: it activates only through an explicit developer opt-in, project sentinel, or protocol-3 HoneyBee workspace binding. Normal batchmode runs remain dormant; a harness-owned headless Editor may activate with HONEYBEE_WORKSPACE_ID. When active, it runs EditMode tests via the TestRunnerApi and reports the same NUnit results.xml a cold batchmode run would produce, over a file-based protocol under <project>/.testplay/bridge/.
